purpose: Test whether the exact frozen Stage2-L geometry lineage can support a factorized contextual relevance interface before any new route collection or R training.

target_lineage.pooling: non-overlapping 4x4 average pooling, identical to the frozen v11.1 consumer
target_lineage.actor_target: stored relevant_actor_support for actors whose future occupancy intersects the ORION path
target_lineage.derived_union_target: elementwise maximum of route_target and actor_target

interface.input: the same U-independent contextual token grid produced from same-view ORION visual evidence, route and ego context
interface.derived_union_probability: elementwise maximum of sigmoid(route logits) and sigmoid(actor logits)
interface.task_relevance_owner: Stage2-L ORION/VLM; factorization does not transfer task responsibility to Stage1

objective.active_component_view_policy: equal foreground and background mass per active view within each component
required_properties: each component has a stationary point at its exact soft target
changing actor target cannot change route loss and changing route target cannot change actor loss
zero-actor groups retain explicit negative supervision instead of being dropped
unsupported views cannot enter a foreground release average
all parameters receive finite gradients in CPU tests

decision_rules.component_lineage_or_objective_test_fail: Repair target/interface implementation; do not add data or run a GPU smoke.
decision_rules.factorization_reveals_no_identifiable_ac: Freeze Stage2-L actor generalization as unidentifiable and expand independent event coverage using a separate prospective geometry protocol.
decision_rules.factorization_is_identifiable_on_at_leas: Freeze a bounded factorized-R-only smoke proposal; a separate authorization remains required.
decision_rules.back_right_remains_unsupported: Declare CAM_BACK_RIGHT outside the empirical claim instead of fabricating a universal gate.

claim_boundary: CPU interface and supervision-identifiability preflight only. Passing cannot establish semantic R correctness, U correctness, VLM language understanding, planning benefit or closed-loop safety.
